g.text: Tapered conduit; octave vent induces node for upper register
Ebonite beak; dual knurled-screw gold clamp
Arundo donax cane; vibrating blade initiates standing wave
Continuously expanding tube produces full harmonic series
Pivot hinge linkage relays finger touch to distant cups
Airtight kidskin pads shift effective tube acoustic length
Curved return directs expanding air column upward
sound waves into ambient room air
Largest tone holes; sturdy sculpted brass
Acoustic Principle: Woodwind physics housed in brass. The single reed initiates oscillation; tone hole pads alter the effective tube length.
